title: Rust: gateway traffic-class admission wiring
description:
Route gateway-originated, forwarded, control, SOS and retry traffic in rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs through the common receiver-aware admission and accounting path in rust/lichen-node/src/stack.rs. Use the existing finite-resource and timing contracts so no gateway traffic class bypasses grant ownership, receiver commitments, full-operation fit, synchronization or legal/adaptive physical-resource restrictions. Keep existing bounded queues, deadlines and back-pressure.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: This extracts gateway traffic wiring from the former rust.14 scope. Reuse rust.13's integrated node path, rust.05 resource admission, rust.07 execution and rust.10/.11 accounting/restart behavior; do not add another scheduler, ledger or framework. Capability publication belongs to rust.14.capabilities, with their combined qualification in rust.14. Preserve upstream radio-owned identity, baseline SCHC/security, existing custody policy and deferred key portability. No audited OSCORE/EDHOC edits, hardware ports, RF operation or new legal fallback is authorized.
acceptance_criteria: Use independent vectors.04/.06/.08/.09 traces through real gateway entry points and deterministic HAL calls. For every traffic class, test missing/expired grant, committed RX, invalid sync, setup or CCA consuming slack, exhausted budget and alias-frequency accounting. Assert rejected operations never reach transmit and admitted emissions are charged exactly once without treating completion as delivery. Extend rust/lichen-gateway/tests and relevant node integration tests with the checked-in hosted feature sets; run applicable shared-crate no_std checks, fmt and scoped clippy. Preserve legacy expectations and use no self-oracle tests.
